bluf: Websolute is a listed Italian AI first digital agency, the lead company of what its headline calls a group of 8 specialist agencies with 230+ professionals from 11 offices. It is doing AI assistants and platform builds: seven project pages dated 2026-09-02 to 2026-09-24 describe AI assistants for GS1 Italy and for Pesaro Capitale della Cultura, a Shopify store with an AI assistant, a fundraising programme, a portal and brand sites, while 16 LinkedIn company ads pitch modular architecture. openings:
Lead with the layer it does not sell: P2 is absent, no feed, schema or entity work on a core web or commerce line, and Data & Measurement scores 0, so the AI assistants it builds for GS1 Italy, Pesaro and Farmacia Carli ship with no machine readable layer and no measurement line in the record. A rival that pairs entity and feed work with a measurement plan for an assistant already live is likely, at moderate confidence, to win the proof conversation, and the KJ9 exposure (measurement gets worse before it gets better, SEO -1) is unhedged; the falsifier is a Websolute page or case study describing schema, feed or entity work, or an audited AI visibility scorecard, entering the record.

Pricing is the second opening: no public model, P5 unknown, a FAQ on what an LLM costs but nothing on what Websolute costs, so a transparent outcome priced offer is a conversation it cannot have in public. Third, the paid message and the label diverge: the 16 LinkedIn ads pitch modular architecture, not AI, so there is a roughly even chance, low confidence, that the AI first positioning runs ahead of what it sells in market. Contestable ground: the no profit fundraising work (VIDAS, Lega del Filo d'Oro) and the tourism assistant model (Pesaro), where an outcome number undercuts a group selling headcount, and the named book itself, five entries of which three are sector pages, so very likely thinner than 52 case studies suggest.
